front.title: Use Cases and Practices for Intent-Based Networking

author.organization: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

abstract.t: This document proposes a methodology to construct an Intent-Based Networking (IBN) system. According to this methodogy, it decribes several use cases of IBN. The methodology for the IBN system includes data collection for system awareness in the IBN system and then the construction of the IBN system. This construction consists of intent translation, policy translation, policy verification, policy deployment, policy monitoring, policy validation, policy optimization, and intent report. In addition, practices are also summarized to instruct the construction of next generation network management systems with the integration of IBN techniques. Finally, this document discusses three aspects for the deployment of the IBN system on the real world. They are Multi-Domain Dichotomy for IBN, the Integration of IBN and Network Digital Twin (NDT), and IBN with Artificial Intelligence (AI).
